Titel: SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect (Central Finance), Contract
Unternehmen: Thamesreach Advisory Ltd.
Ort: London (Vereinigtes Königreich)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4187733508/
Abgerufen am: 23.09.2026 07:00

About the job
Thamesreach Advisory is retained by a listed consumer goods group to lead the design authority of its finance transformation. We are looking for an experienced contractor to act as Finance Solution Architect.

Context
The group operates 23 ERP instances across Europe and North America, most of them SAP ECC, some Oracle and JD Edwards. As the first step towards a single S/4HANA core, the programme implements SAP Central Finance to harmonise group reporting, intercompany processes and the close. A shared service centre in Frankfurt will take over accounting for the German, Austrian and Swiss entities.

Responsibilities
Own the end-to-end solution design for record to report, intercompany and cost allocation
Define the replication scope, mapping (MDG) and error handling concept for Central Finance
Lead design workshops with finance process owners and the system integrator
Review functional specifications and challenge the integrator on scope and effort
Align the chart of accounts, profit centre and segment structure with group reporting
Support the business case and the roadmap towards a full S/4HANA migration
Contribute to steering committee materials and design authority decisions

Requirements
At least ten years of SAP FI/CO experience, including solution architect roles
Hands-on delivery of at least one Central Finance implementation
Deep understanding of IFRS group reporting and intercompany reconciliation
Experience with SAP MDG, SLT and the Universal Journal
Confident communication with CFO level stakeholders

Nice to have
SAP Group Reporting, BlackLine, experience with shared service centre set-ups
German language skills

Contract details
Day rate GBP 750 to 850, outside IR35
Remote first, based in the UK; travel to London and to the Frankfurt shared service centre about 25 %
Right to work in the UK required, no sponsorship available
Start 2 November 2026, initial term 9 months
